item.title: MirrorCam 1.4.8
item.description: - Full screen: the gray bar no longer drops over the top of the mirror. Pointing at the top of the screen shows the menu bar only; Esc or ⌃⌘F leaves full screen - Double-click the top of the window (or Window › Zoom) and it fills the screen; again, and it goes back to the size it was - Enhance no longer changes the picture's color, which could turn a room yellow in daylight. It brightens a dim or backlit face, as before - Settings matches ConvertExt's point for point, with its rows in two boxes
